rotation: Inflation risks and monetary policy uncertainty favor sectors like utilities and consumer staples, which tend to perform well in stable interest rate environments. Geopolitical instability pressures energy and materials sectors, while the AI investment boom and productivity puzzle favor tech and IT services. Labor market stabilization amid shifting dynamics supports healthcare and consumer discretionary sectors. Tariff policy and trade deficit concerns pressure exporters and import-sensitive sectors.
